# Made-in-China.com

> > Made-in-China.com is a comprehensive B2B marketplace connecting global buyers with Chinese manufacturers and suppliers across industrial equipment, electronics, custom manufacturing, and thousands of product categories.

Operated by Focus Technology Co., Ltd., the platform features verified supplier profiles, factory tour booking capabilities, and customization services spanning regions including North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, Africa, and beyond. Suppliers range from ISO 9001/14001 certified manufacturers in Guangdong, Shenzhen, Shandong, and Henan provinces offering machinery, LED lighting, CNC equipment, optical fiber cables, doors, windows, and custom gifts.

## Key Topics

- China manufacturers
- B2B supplier directory

## Platform Overview

- [Made-in-China.com Homepage](https://made-in-china.com): Main B2B marketplace platform connecting global buyers with Chinese manufacturers and suppliers
- [Custom Products Channel](https://custom.made-in-china.com): Customization services hub for apparel, gifts, bags, and other personalized manufacturing requests
- [Custom Bag Manufacturing](https://custom.made-in-china.com/bag.html): Find suppliers specializing in customized bag products and manufacturing services
